Gender roles are traditional expectations of behavior based on someone's gender. These expectations have been historically prescribed by men and women and are not always contributed by either gender or accurate.

Most people have shades of gray when it comes to gender, and not all expectations around gender are beneficial, especially in the context of sexism. We should not define women and men by their roles.
